spec.situation_desc: transferred money to someone pretending to be from the bank

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Hannah speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Rhys Ferreira. Someone called pretending to be from the bank and talked me into transferring £2,400. I’m really unhappy with how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m very sorry that’s happened, Rhys. I can hear how upsetting and frustrating it must be. Before we discuss anything about your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I’ll log this as a complaint. I’m sure we’ll get the money returned to you once we look into it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I hope so. They said they were calling from the fraud team and told me to move it to a safe account.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you were put in that position. We’ll review what happened, and you’ll hear back from us within eight weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Eight weeks? That seems a long time.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. To summarise, I’ve logged your complaint about being persuaded to transfer £2,400 to someone impersonating the bank, and you’ll hear back within eight weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, I understand. I’m still not happy, though.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s completely understandable, Rhys. Thank you for explaining what happened, and I’m sorry for the distress this has caused.
